description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories within a dataset, with each slice representing a specific category and its corresponding proportion of the total. The largest segment, colored red, corresponds to "Math" and accounts for 29.3% of the dataset, with a total count of 410,756 instances. The second-largest segment, in blue, represents "Coding" at 24.3% (339,907 instances). The third-largest segment, light green, is "Information Seeking," making up 22.2% (311,427 instances). The "Reasoning" category, shown in orange, constitutes 10.4% (145,329 instances). Smaller segments include "Planning" in light purple (2.3%, 31,757 instances), "Creative Writing" in pink (2.2%, 30,144 instances), and "Others (combined)" in light green (9.3%, 130,671 instances). The chart includes a legend on the left that lists all categories with their respective counts and colors, and percentage labels are displayed directly on or near each slice. The segments are arranged in descending order of size in a clockwise direction, starting with "Math" at the top left.
